question: Compare retention durations and overrides at Lenwick Canal Transit and Rillpoint Lightstation.

ui.answer:
[1] Lenwick Canal Transit voyage logs are retained for 3 years, unless a navigation inquiry requires longer retention.

[2] Rillpoint Lightstation observation journals are retained for 11 years, unless a heritage inquiry requires longer retention.
